Reusable [draw.io](https://app.diagrams.net/) templates for common diagrams.

## Available Templates

### Gantt Chart

Source: [`gantt-chart/gantt-chart.drawio`](gantt-chart/gantt-chart.drawio)

| Theme | Preview |
|---|---|
| Bland | ![Bland](gantt-chart/gantt-chart-bland.png) |
| Rose | ![Rose](gantt-chart/gantt-chart-rose.png) |
| Bomb Pop | ![Bomb Pop](gantt-chart/gantt-chart-bomb-pop.png) |
| Cotton Candy | ![Cotton Candy](gantt-chart/gantt-chart-cotton-candy.png) |
| Hulk | ![Hulk](gantt-chart/gantt-chart-hulk.png) |

## Usage

1. Download the `.drawio` file from the template directory.
2. Open in [draw.io](https://app.diagrams.net/) (web or desktop).
3. Customize for your project.
